hyps.why: Replacing a parameter-free avg_pool with a 3x3 conv gives far larger gains than replacing an existing conv or none.
Upgrading a parameter-free pooling edge to a 3x3 conv helps much more than modifying an edge that already has a conv.
Adding a 3x3 conv on the output edge in place of avg_pool gains more than replacing a 1x1 conv or none.
Removing a parameter-free pooling edge costs little or helps, while removing a conv or skip edge usually hurts.
Downgrading edge 2 from a 3x3 conv to a 1x1 conv reduces accuracy, unlike converting a parameter-free op to a conv.
When the input edge is just pooling, dropping edge 1 is harmless or beneficial, whereas with conv-rich parents it hurts.
Replacing a 1x1 conv with a 3x3 conv gives only a small gain compared with replacing a parameter-free op.
Upgrading 1x1 to 3x3 on edge 0 gives a modest gain versus the huge gain from replacing avg_pool or skip.
Removing a parameter-free avg_pool output edge helps, while removing a conv edge hurts.
Removing a skip edge in a degenerate parameter-free cell improves accuracy, while removing it in conv-containing cells has little effect.
